items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: Whoever orders the agent pays: a landlord's agent cannot charge you. One you hire is paid only for a home offered to you alone, once you sign, at most two months' net cold rent plus VAT.

items.title: The rent brake
items.text: At signing the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than ten percent, exceptions aside. We check, furniture surcharge included.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: At most three months' cold rent, in three instalments, kept apart from the landlord's money. Anything more is not legal.

items.title: Cold or warm
items.text: The listed rent is often cold. We read the Nebenkosten advance, what it covers, and what the yearly settlement can add.

papers.summary: The papers a German landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest we go through on the free call.

items.q: When do I pay a rental agent in Berlin?
items.a: Only when you sign the lease: in Germany an agent may take nothing before, and a landlord's agent cannot charge you. BOOM Berlin charges Full Search only for a home its landlord let us offer to you alone; if you never sign, you pay nothing.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call, or before you sign a lease.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Berlin from abroad?
items.a: Never transfer a deposit or first rent for a flat nobody on your side has seen, and never pay an agent before a lease is signed. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report, charged only if you sign. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the lease and the rent brake before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: Then you pay nothing: every fare is charged only when you sign the lease we helped you get. We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Berlin, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome. Hired and paid by the tenant only, when the lease is signed, never before.
Expats and internationals relocating to Berlin — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English; the self-disclosure and cover note go in German.
Nothing from landlords or platforms, always inside the German cap.

German-format dossier within one working day of your papers, homes a landlord lets us offer to you alone, attended viewings with live video and written report, rent brake and lease checked before you sign, Anmeldung supported.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't collect your rent or deposit, we don't promise a date, and we charge nothing before you sign.
